chunks: Ali ibn al-Hasan ibn Fadhl narrated from Muhammad ibn Ali, from Muhammad ibn Isma'il ibn Bazee', from Mansur Buruj, from Abd al-Hamid ibn Awadd, who said:

I said to Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him): 'When a woman, I marry her, is it permissible for me to have sexual relations with her without having paid her anything from her dowry?' He said, 'Yes, it is merely a debt upon you.'

key_terms.أَنْ أُوَاقِعَهَا: to have sexual relations with her

ai.seo_question: Can a husband have sexual relations with his wife before paying her full dowry?
ai.summary: In this narration from *Tahdhib al-Ahkam*, Imam al-Sadiq clarifies that the payment of the dowry (mahr) is not a prerequisite for the validity of consummation, distinguishing between the contractual obligation and the physical act. By stating 'it is a debt upon you,' the Imam emphasizes that the mahr remains a financial liability (dayn) payable at the wife's discretion, reflecting the Shia juristic view that mahr is a right of the wife rather than a condition for the marriage contract's efficacy. This ruling underscores the flexibility in marital relations while ensuring the wife's financial security is preserved as an enforceable debt.
